zh.title: 新功能
items: **本地 MCP 连接支持 OAuth 2.0 授权**：连接本地 MCP 服务时支持标准 OAuth 2.0 授权码流程，接入需要登录的 MCP 服务更加顺畅。

zh.title: 优化
items: 上下文用量估算更准确：计入工具 schema 的占用并修正中日韩字符的计数方式，用量进度条更贴近真实情况。
统一上下文用量为完整会话量口径，消除回合结束时进度条数值跳变的问题。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复读取含工具调用语法的文本后，模型可能把工具指令输出到正文并导致回合中断的问题；同时增加响应守卫兜底，自动纠偏。
修复历史压缩时未复用已解析的 provider 配置的问题。
修复模型下拉菜单被遮挡、裁剪的显示问题。

en.title: What's New
items: **Local MCP connections support OAuth 2.0**: standard authorization-code flow makes login-required MCP services smoother to connect.

en.title: Improvements
items: More accurate context usage estimates: tool schemas are counted and CJK character weighting is corrected.
Context usage uses full-session accounting so the progress bar no longer jumps at turn end.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed cases where reading text with tool-call syntax could leak tool instructions into the body and break the turn; response guards auto-correct.
History compaction now reuses the already-resolved provider config.
Fixed model dropdown menus being clipped or covered.
